# GuideLink v0.1.6

**Prefer higher resolution** now enables m3u-editor's **Probe Live streams after
sync** setting on the assigned playlist. This collects stream metadata after
provider imports, supporting later resolution-based primary selection.

## Behaviour

- Preview Sync reports the proposed probing change. Run Sync applies it through
  the existing native auto-merge setup, including scheduled syncs in apply mode.
- While the resolution preference is enabled, later syncs restore the probing
  switch if it is turned off directly in m3u-editor.
- Turning the resolution preference off stops enforcement and preserves the
  current probing setting.
- Existing only-unprobed, include-disabled, per-channel opt-out, timeout,
  batching and VOD probing choices are preserved. Additional backup playlists
  retain their own settings.
- GuideLink's metadata sync continues using saved statistics and does not start
  a scan. The stream checker still handles live/dead checks separately. Native
  merge jobs can probe eligible candidates with missing resolution statistics,
  including hidden backups skipped by enabled-only automatic probing.

## Upgrade

Install `guidelink.zip` through the
[reviewed update flow](https://github.com/djrarky/GuideLink/blob/v0.1.6/docs/INSTALL.md#update-an-existing-install).
Profiles and assignments are preserved; no schema migration, new profile field
or host code change is required.

**Prefer higher resolution defaults to enabled.** After updating, the next Run
Sync or scheduled apply sync will therefore enable automatic live metadata
probing for profiles using that preference. Preview Sync shows the change first.
Installing the update alone does not change playlist settings or launch probing.

Download `guidelink.zip` for installation. `SHA256SUMS` verifies the assets and
`release.json` records the packaged file hashes.

## Validation

On host commit `7943b2171` (m3u-editor 0.13.6 with the plugin UI patch), PHP 8.4:

- Full plugin suite: **262 tests** passed on each of SQLite and PostgreSQL 16.
- All 115 PHP files passed syntax and formatting checks. Standalone plugin
  validation and all nine release-tool tests passed.
- The packaged archive passed native reviewed installation, trust, integrity
  verification and registry checks in an isolated host using the fake scanner.

Regression tests cover preview isolation, application and repeated enforcement,
releasing control while preserving either native switch value, preservation of
other probing settings and backup playlists, scheduled assignments, rollback,
and the absence of probe dispatch during GuideLink sync.

Tests use isolated databases and synthetic streams; no live provider playback
scan was started for this release.
